en.about_bio: I work with Wwise, C++, and Unreal Engine. I build audio systems that work in games—not just sounds that play, but systems that respond to what's happening.

en.value_systems_desc: Not Today Darling: Interactive music system implementation that adapts to race intensity. Pause & Deserve: horror audio that responds to how you use pause.
en.value_tools_desc: Wwise Unreal Fixer: fixes 200+ broken references after Wwise updates. Unreal Rebuilder: cuts build time in half. AudioLab: ML beatbox classifier with 45ms latency.
en.value_technical_desc: AudioQ EQ plugin in C++/JUCE. Python ML for beatbox classification. Blueprint hooks for Wwise events. Memory profiling in Unreal.
en.principle_clarity_desc: Game audio must be clear. What does the player need to hear right now? Mix hierarchy, frequency separation, ducking. Player gets info, not noise.
en.principle_technical_desc: Know the limits: voice counts, memory, CPU. I build systems that work in prototype and scale to production without breaking budget.
en.principle_layering_desc: I design sounds in layers: transient for punch, body for weight, texture for character. Parameters (speed, intensity, distance) blend them in real-time. Sounds respond to gameplay.
en.principle_collaboration_desc: Audio needs input from designers, programmers, and players. I document systems, explain decisions, and iterate based on playtests. Audio ships when the game ships.
en.cta_desc: Looking for 2026 internship in game audio. 3-6 months, EU passport, relocation-ready.
en.achievement_thesis_desc: Built Unity + ElevenLabs API prototype for real-time AI audio generation. Built a predictive buffering system to mask generation latency. Tested practical limits of generative audio for interactive gameplay.
en.achievement_tools_desc: Built 2 pipeline tools: Wwise Unreal Fixer and Unreal Engine Rebuilder
en.achievement_games_desc: Led audio implementation on 4 games at DAE (Wwise, MetaSounds, FMOD). Sound design contributions to 8+ additional projects.
